headline: The papers-please line gets regulars
lede: Four hand-authored characters now walk the booth days 2-7 with fixed faces, signature marks that print in the photo too, and papers that come back week after week — the neighborhood the original built its bureaucracy around.

notes.text: PAPERS, PLEASE-MIN: VOLLEN GRUBAK (scar), MARKO DRENIN (mole), ANJA TOLKA (wrinkle) and PETR ZEMEK (big ear) are authored characters, not dice rolls — same descriptor, same mark, same honest papers every time they appear; two of them return inside every week.

The marks paint at the counter AND inside the zoomed passport photo in one ink, and they are decor by doctrine: the PORTRAIT law compares faces exactly as before, six features, never a mark, never a color.

paperscheck grew a REGULARS section (identity law: same id means the same face and mark on face and photo, every seed and day) with mutants m25/m26 proving the witnesses bite — 10752/10752; papersplay counts each mark's pixels through the same drawFace (46/46).

Also this shift: PLAICRAFT S1 got its sixth honest audit — consent gate, seed-birth recorder, replay evidence and offline store sim all verified green on main; the issue waits on the R2 bucket and three phone sessions, not on code.
